title: fix(platform-objects): Create User result dialog reads true for a typed password
body:
Fixes #24936

Clause-②: no (text only: the create-user result dialog's sentence and button; no param, response, status, outcome or export moves)

## What changed

`sys_user.create_user`'s result dialog said "Copy the temporary password now — it is shown only once and never stored." with an "I have saved this password" button. It said that in both outcomes. The endpoint (`plugin-auth` `admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `...(resolved.generated ? { temporaryPassword } : {})`) returns `temporaryPassword` only when it generated one. The dialog skips a field whose path is absent from the response, so after a typed password it showed the email alone and still asked the admin to save a password.

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`: the `create_user` `resultDialog` now reads **"If a temporary password was generated, copy it now — it is shown only once and never stored."** with a **"Done"** button. That is the same sentence and button as `set_user_password` in the same file, whose dialog has the same two outcomes. The title, params, `bodyExtra`, handler, response and dialog fields are unchanged.
- `en.objects.generated.ts`: regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` (exit 0), not edited by hand.
- `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` `objects.generated.ts`: the two hand-written leaves now reuse `set_user_password`'s existing translations (如果生成了临时密码… / 完成, 一時パスワードが生成された場合は… / 完了, Si se generó una contraseña temporal… / Hecho). The merge-mode regeneration kept them. None of these leaves has a source-hash entry.
- New pin `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/create-user-result-dialog-copy.test.ts`. It checks the source sentence and button (the button must not mention a saved password), the three dialog fields, and, in all four locales, that the `create_user` dialog's description and button equal `set_user_password`'s.
- Changeset: `patch` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

## Wording choice

`ActionSchema.resultDialog` has no per-outcome copy, so one sentence must hold for both outcomes. I reused `set_user_password`'s sentence and button rather than writing new copy:
- **Real need:** the typed case shows only the email. "Done" claims nothing about a password, and the conditional sentence is true in both cases.
- **Long-term fit:** one hedged sentence for the two dialogs that share this response shape. No spec key for per-outcome copy is added; that is out of scope and `domain:spec`'s.
- **Hard for an AI to get wrong:** the pin ties both dialogs together in every locale, so they cannot drift apart without a red test.
- **No scope growth:** text only, and the translations already exist in the catalog.

## Pins and fixtures

- `packages/cli/test/i18n-extract.test.ts` has its own `set_password` fixture with different text ("…shown only once."). It does not quote this object and does not move.
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts` has its own inline `createUser` object and inline zh-CN bundle. It imports nothing from `platform-objects` and does not move.
- No pin in another lane moved.

Restored: blob == HEAD `bc6b1792`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2 (locale): put the old zh-CN leaves back (blob `c6d8953c` → `5326f33a`). 1 of 4 went red ("every locale says the same thing as set_user_password…"). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- I did not check objectui's dialog renderer locally, because objectui is not in this container. That it skips an absent `temporaryPassword` comes from the card's seat review and the existing code comment on the `fields` list. The renderer is unchanged here.
